notes.title: Official Release!
notes.content:
We might look like a legit game studio, but to be honest we're just a couple guys with a passion for gaming. Two years ago, neither of us imagined we would be publishing a game on Steam. That's what makes this moment special for us. We've taken a completely original idea and followed through with it to the end. For two indie gamers like us, it is an accomplishment to be proud of.

I really want to thank everyone that has supported us throughout our journey. I have learned tons about game making since the start of this, which is really what it has been about from the beginning. Peter has been a great partner, and I really appreciate how graciously he put up with me every time I changed the plan and went in a new direction. He's the best.

Thanks for checking us out, and I hope you enjoy what we have put together. It might not be much, but if it makes a few people smile, then it was well worth it.
